title: Minas Velti
description: Minas Velti was a Jedi master during the Clone Wars. Cancellor Sheev Palpatine, who was really Darth Sidious, instigated Order 66 to wipe out the Jedi. Darth Vader led an attack on the Jedi Temple where Velti was working with her young students. Velti fought valiantly to protect her students from the Clone Troopers, but died in the effort.
